_about: Legendary slot (1st to 6th) each item is first bought in, per champion: counts from the purchase timelines of all ten players in the owner's archived Mayhem games (1,206 games, 12,060 player rows, 2026-01-18 to 2026-11-20). Legendary = any non-boots item in a feed build list. Only the slot comes from here; item choice and DeepScore come from the stats feeds. Read by web/src/lib/champion-page.ts.
